categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches CI Nix cross-compilation environment for Windows builds and carries the Tests label.
categories.rationale: Fixes an environment mismatch so CI tests the same GCC thread model used in release binaries. As described in #36314, 'Nixpkgs toolchain defaults to mcf' whereas 'Guix release binaries use GCC’s POSIX thread model', meaning tested Windows binaries differed in threading behavior from production releases.
